item.title: Ama Imo! Amaenbou de Guutara na Imouto no Ecchi na Yuuwaku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mount Position
  • 発売日: 2018-09-28
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あま妹！ 甘えん坊でぐーたらな妹のえっちな誘惑
  • 英語名: Ama Imo! Amaenbou de Guutara na Imouto no Ecchi na Yuuwaku

あらすじ

While their parents were away, the protagonist, Itsuki, was asked to look after his younger sister and returned to his family home.

There, he found his sister, Hinano, lounging lazily on the couch as usual, playing video games.

Itsuki scolded his messy sister but still took care of her.

  • 日本語名: おね恋 ～夜のぼくはエッチな従姉のおもちゃになる～
  • 英語名: One Love Yoru no Boku wa Ecchi na Onee-chan no Omocha ni Naru

あらすじ

Yuu has just started his sophomore year but his cousin, Rin, suddenly comes to his school to work as a trainee teacher. Since they haven’t seen each other for a long time and Rin has become quite beautiful, he starts to see her as a woman. However, she still treats him like a younger brother.

  • 英語名: Icha Love Dousei Seikatsu -Osananajimi to Asa kara Ban made Icha Icha Icha Icha-

あらすじ

Childhood friends Kengo and Mutsumi like each other, but they never have the chance to confess. One day, due to protecting Mutsumi, Kengo gets into an accident and injures his hand.

Since he lives alone, this is a great inconvenience. However, Mutsumi suggests that she will live with him and take care of everything. And so, their erotic life begins.
